plan.reason: The forecast predicts a warm afternoon with temperatures reaching up to 25.0°C (23.5°C at 19:00). Given that the interior core zones are already at 25.0°C and will likely continue to heat further, setting the supply air ceiling at 17.3°C would not be sufficient to prevent overheating in these areas. To ensure comfort without overcooling other zones, a higher ceiling of 18.0°C is chosen. This allows for some margin above the forecasted warmest point while still maintaining efficiency by reducing reheat loads.
